readout_other: EEG alpha and theta power during a control illusion task; visual analogue scale self-ratings of control, effort and worry
direction_notes: litFUS changed the relationship between stimulus rate and F8 alpha power and altered the relationship of Fz theta with effort and worrying, but did not change self-rated control perception.

target.label: right inferior frontal gyrus of the lateral prefrontal cortex, F8 electrode position

timing.protocol_description: 120 s of litFUS at F8 with 0.5% duty cycle and 40 Hz PRF, applied about 40 min before the EEG task; sham was the same device pointed away from the scalp.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of 41 healthy volunteers were investigated after collecting written consent.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Each volunteer received either sham or litFUS modulation at session one and the remaining at session two.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Its administration lasted for 120 s with a duty cycle of 0.5%, a frequency of 500 kHz, and a pulse repetition frequency of 40 Hz leading to an acoustic power of 199 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> and a mechanical index of 1.53.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: Its administration lasted for 120 s with a duty cycle of 0.5%, a frequency of 500 kHz, and a pulse repetition frequency of 40 Hz leading to an acoustic power of 199 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> and a mechanical index of 1.53.
